name: GrailPeople Shopping
description:
GrailPeople Shopping answers any beauty or skincare shopping question with real evidence — what dermatologists, estheticians, makeup artists, and beauty creators actually said on camera, with direct quotes and video timestamps.

Ask it the way you'd ask a friend:
Best moisturizer for oily skin. What should I use for acne? Build me a morning skincare routine. Best Cetaphil products. Is CeraVe actually good or just hyped? What's a good drugstore dupe for Charlotte Tilbury? Best serum for dark spots and hyperpigmentation. Sunscreen that doesn't leave a white cast. Foundation for dry, textured skin. What concealer should I get? Eyeshadow palette for a wedding. Best K-beauty moisturizer for sensitive skin. Shampoo for thinning hair. Body lotion for keratosis pilaris. Retinol for beginners. Best under $30.

Covers skincare, makeup, hair care, and body care — cleansers, serums, moisturizers, sunscreen, retinol, vitamin C, exfoliants, masks, foundation, concealer, blush, bronzer, mascara, lip products, shampoo, conditioner, treatments, and tools. Filter by ingredient, skin concern, skin type, skin tone, budget, retailer, or origin, from drugstore to K-beauty to luxury.

Every recommendation is ranked by how strongly real creators endorsed it — never by payment. Sponsored reviews are flagged, and mixed or negative verdicts show up right alongside the raves, so you get an honest read instead of a highlight reel.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GrailPeople Shopping to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GrailPeople Shopping to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://grailpeople.com/api/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is GrailPeople Shopping MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, GrailPeople Shopping scores 96/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GrailPeople Shopping MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GrailPeople Shopping provides these MCP tools: find_brand_or_creator, get_brand_reviews, get_creator_recommendations, get_product_reviews, and search_beauty_products.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GrailPeople Shopping?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GrailPeople Shopping in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does GrailPeople Shopping MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: GrailPeople Shopping does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
GrailPeople Shopping is developed by GrailPeople Shopping. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
